name: Jquery Fireworks
description: Renders canvas-based fireworks animations, exposed as a configurable block.
project_description:
Introduction: 

 Do you want to add some sparkle to your Drupal website? If so, then the jQuery Fireworks module is the perfect solution for you. This module allows you to add realistic fireworks animations to your website, making it more visually appealing and engaging.

 Features: 

 The jQuery Fireworks module has a number of features that make it a great choice for adding fireworks animations to your website. These features include:

 Easy to use: The module is very easy to use, even for beginners. Simply install the module and then configure it to your liking.

Flexible: The module is very flexible, allowing you to customize the fireworks animations to match your website's design.

Responsive: The module is responsive, meaning that the fireworks animations will look great on all devices, including desktops, laptops, tablets, and smartphones.

Benefits:

 There are a number of benefits to using the jQuery Fireworks module for Drupal. These benefits include:

 Increased engagement : The fireworks animations can help to increase engagement with your website by making it more visually appealing and engaging.

 Improved branding : The fireworks animations can help to improve your website's branding by making it more unique and memorable.

Increased traffic: The fireworks animations can help to increase traffic to your website by making it more visually appealing and engaging.

 Conclusion: 

 If you are looking for a way to add some sparkle to your Drupal website, then the jQuery Fireworks module is the perfect solution for you. This module is easy to use, flexible, and responsive, and it can help to increase engagement, improve branding, and increase traffic to your website.

 A simple-to-use and fully jQuery plugin is used to create realistic fireworks(celebration) animations.

 Under the "Canvas based fireworks" block you can set this to all pages or particular pages. Drupal Block provides a lot of settings.

 CONFIGURATION

-------------

 1. Install the module "Jquery Fireworks".

 2. Go to the “Block Layout”. Eg:- Admin Menu >> structure >> block layout

 3. Go to your block region where you want to put it.

 4. Click the "Place block" button and in the modal dialog click the

 "Place block" button next to "Canvas based fireworks".

 5. Click on the Save block button.
